name: Bar Lehmann
abstract_title: Meditative Endpoint Cessation Collapses EEG activity from Higher Dimensional to a More Unified and Lower Dimensional Covariance Manifold
abstract: Cessation, known as nirodha in Buddhism, is a meditative event in which the entirety of conscious experience abruptly ceases and later reconstitutes. Cessation events are a form of meditative endpoint occurring with mastery of meditation and are often described as producing profound clarity and lasting equanimity.
